newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Codex France to set up agricult. JV in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Codex France to set up agricult. JV in Hungary.

text.p: Hungary's state-owned agricultural company, Hod Mezogazda Rt will set up a joint venture with France's agricultural firm Codex France for the joint processing of corn-cob.
The Hungarian partner will contribute 36.15 million forints to the joint venture's 144 million forint capital, said Adam Dudits, spokesman of the privatisation agency APV Rt.
The company will process an annual 15,000 to 20,000 tonnes of corn-cob to be exported to west Europe for use in cosmetics, feed and grinding materials, Dudits said.
The JV will implement 400 million forints of investments in 1997, he said. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 327-4040
